components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single green action on a dashboard view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.375rem; height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--surface); font: 500 14px/1.25 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--primary-active); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--canvas), 0 0 0 4px var(--primary-ring); } @media (pointer: coarse) { .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; } }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary and row actions on white panels.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--text-primary); font: 500 14px/1.25 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--surface-muted); } .ds-btn-outline:active { background: var(--border); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--canvas), 0 0 0 4px var(--primary-ring); } @media (pointer: coarse) { .ds-btn-outline { min-height: 44px; } }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Compact form field with a hairline outline.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 2rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--text-primary); font: 400 14px/1.25 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; outline: none; transition: border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-tertiary); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--primary); box-shadow: var(--shadow-focus); } .ds-input:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.6; }

components.name: Surface Panel
components.description: Flat bordered container for lists and table data.
components.css: .ds-panel { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--text-primary); } .ds-panel-title { margin: 0; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); font: 600 14px/1.25 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 1.25rem; padding: 0 0.5rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--primary-soft); color: var(--primary-soft-foreground); font: 500 12px/1 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: Sidebar link with the 2px green selection rail.
components.html: Clientes
components.css: .ds-nav-active { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.625rem; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--nav-active-bg); color: var(--nav-active-foreground); font: 500 14px/1.25 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-active::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0.375rem; bottom: 0.375rem; left: 0; width: 2px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--primary); } .ds-nav-active:hover { background: var(--nav-active-bg); } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (pointer: coarse) { .ds-nav-active { height: 44px; } }

narrative.overview:
This is a compact, product-grade control surface in the lineage of Supabase and Vercel dashboards: near-white ground, paper-white panels, hairline separators, small radii, 14px type and almost no shadow. It is built for an owner checking records on a phone in short sessions, so the hierarchy is flattened and the frequent action stays close to the thumb. Brand expression is restricted to one green used for action, selection, focus and success.

The system deliberately refuses the padded, floating-card dashboard and the desktop sidebar that simply vanishes on mobile. Navigation is always reachable: a 240px rail on large screens, the same content in a slide-in drawer below lg. Modules that are not implemented are labelled Pronto instead of pretending to work.
keyCharacteristics: Hairline-first surfaces, flat at rest, with depth reserved for overlays.
One accent green; neutral grays, black and white carry everything else.
Compact desktop density, 44px touch targets on phones, one primary action per view.
Honest navigation and text-labelled status in every state.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Green is the only accent. Do not introduce a second brand hue for decoration; status colors are semantic exceptions with text labels, not alternate accents.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: A resting panel gets one hairline border and no shadow. Never stack a border with a large ambient halo.

dos: Do use semantic utilities such as bg-surface, text-muted-foreground, bg-primary and border-border.
Do keep one primary green action per view and make it full-width on phones.
Do give every control a visible focus ring and every touch target at least 44px on coarse pointers.
Do label upcoming modules and empty states with plain Spanish copy.
Do use tabular-data for anything numeric or date-based.
donts: Don't add shadows to resting cards or panels; depth is for overlays only.
Don't use color alone for state, or introduce a second accent hue.
Don't hide navigation on mobile without providing the drawer equivalent.
Don't use raw --brand-* or --neutral-* values in feature code.
Don't claim an unimplemented module works; route it to the honest placeholder.
